<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~192.103 Da. The isotopic distribution (≈12.5 % M+1, ~1 % M+2) suggests a molecule with about 12 carbons. The formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂ has a monoisotopic mass of 192.115 Da, which is the closest match and fits the observed isotopic pattern, making it the most plausible molecular formula.  

**Molecular formula:** C12H16O2</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
